# Supplemental dependency notices

These files are copied from the upstream commits recorded in each published
crate's `.cargo_vcs_info.json`, because those crates omit their license files.
`SOURCES.json` maps each copy to its immutable upstream URL. Do not silently reuse
these supplements for a new dependency version: inspect that version's provenance.

The objc2 family publishes an upstream licensing explanation rather than complete
standard-license text. It is retained verbatim here, including upstream links and
SDK attribution notes. This collection does not resolve upstream licensing questions.
